sources: Buildings, floors, use and year: Dirección General del Catastro (INSPIRE buildings); streets and land use: OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL); ground: IGN MDT05 (CC BY 4.0); tree crowns: detected from the PNOA orthophoto (IGN, CC BY 4.0), approximate
